reuse.why: Adds one getRangeAmount and routes the existing getScheduledAmount through it, but the server/shared sites keep their own null/number/range dispatch rather than calling getScheduledAmount, which already handles numbers and ranges.

duplication.why: All copies of the midpoint arithmetic collapse into one function; the per-site typeof-number ternaries remain repeated as before.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount.

scope.why: Only the ranged-amount sites, comments, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The rule now has one definition; the residual dispatch at each site is minor noise a maintainer can live with.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and schedule-template.ts keep their own number-vs-range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount and every ranged-amount site.
